summary: Candidate is a focused, non-redundant reference asset on maximum tf normalization and documented failure modes (length bias, stop word sensitivity, outlier instability). Peer candidates cover broader tf-idf theory (a45c7e44), general tf-idf computation (4e22b826), and storage optimization (1af988c0), but none specifically address maximum tf normalization techniques, smoothing parameters, or the specific failure modes documented here. The candidate fills a distinct gap in operational guidance for tf normalization design decisions.
